601.en: The city offers plenty of entertainment, from cinemas to concerts.
601.zh: 这座城市娱乐活动丰富，从电影院到音乐会应有尽有。

602.en: The population of the town has doubled in twenty years.
602.zh: 这个镇的人口在二十年里翻了一番。

603.en: She is studying medicine and wants to become a surgeon.
603.zh: 她在学医，想成为一名外科医生。

604.en: In biology we studied how plants convert sunlight into energy.
604.zh: 生物课上我们学习了植物如何将阳光转化为能量。

605.en: The chemistry lab is on the third floor of the science building.
605.zh: 化学实验室在科学楼三层。

606.en: He finds physics difficult but fascinating.
606.zh: 他觉得物理很难但很迷人。

607.en: A good grade in mathematics is required for this course.
607.zh: 这门课程要求数学成绩优良。

608.en: In geography we learned how rivers shape the landscape.
608.zh: 地理课上我们学习了河流如何塑造地貌。

609.en: Psychology explores how people think, feel and behave.
609.zh: 心理学探究人们如何思考、感受和行动。

610.en: Her sociology essay examines how cities change family life.
610.zh: 她的社会学论文考察城市如何改变家庭生活。

611.en: He switched from economics to environmental science in his second year.
611.zh: 他在大二时从经济学转到了环境科学。

612.en: Philosophy teaches you to question your own assumptions.
612.zh: 哲学教你质疑自己的假设。

613.en: Civil engineering involves designing bridges, roads and dams.
613.zh: 土木工程涉及桥梁、道路和大坝的设计。

614.en: She is studying architecture and dreams of designing museums.
614.zh: 她在学建筑学，梦想设计博物馆。

615.en: Modern agriculture depends heavily on irrigation.
615.zh: 现代农业在很大程度上依赖灌溉。

616.en: Tourism is the island's main source of income.
616.zh: 旅游业是这座岛的主要收入来源。

617.en: Public transportation in this city is cheap and reliable.
617.zh: 这座城市的公共交通便宜又可靠。

618.en: The university guarantees accommodation for all first-year students.
618.zh: 大学保证为所有一年级学生提供住宿。

619.en: I'd like to make a reservation for two nights next week.
619.zh: 我想预订下周的两晚住宿。

620.en: The island is a popular destination for honeymoon couples.
620.zh: 这座岛是蜜月旅行的热门目的地。

621.en: Please arrive at the airport two hours before departure.
621.zh: 请在起飞前两小时到达机场。

622.en: On arrival, all guests receive a welcome pack.
622.zh: 所有客人到达时都会收到一份欢迎礼包。

623.en: The train journey from here to the coast takes three hours.
623.zh: 从这里到海边的火车旅程需要三个小时。

624.en: The voyage across the Atlantic took ten days.
624.zh: 横渡大西洋的航行花了十天。

625.en: The trip to the rainforest was a real adventure.
625.zh: 这次雨林之行是一次真正的冒险。

626.en: Teaching abroad was a valuable experience for her.
626.zh: 在国外教书对她来说是一段宝贵的经历。

627.en: A good guide needs detailed knowledge of local history.
627.zh: 一名好导游需要对当地历史有详尽的了解。

628.en: Note-taking is an essential skill for lectures.
628.zh: 记笔记是听讲座必备的技能。

629.en: The course develops your ability to think critically.
629.zh: 这门课程培养你的批判性思维能力。

630.en: She showed a talent for languages at an early age.
630.zh: 她很小就展现出语言天赋。

631.en: Winning the scholarship was her proudest achievement.
631.zh: 获得奖学金是她最自豪的成就。

632.en: The success of the project depends on careful planning.
632.zh: 项目的成功取决于周密的计划。

633.en: Failure is often the first step towards success.
633.zh: 失败往往是通向成功的第一步。

634.en: Writing a thesis in a second language is a real challenge.
634.zh: 用第二语言写论文是一项真正的挑战。

635.en: The internship is a great opportunity to gain work experience.
635.zh: 这次实习是获得工作经验的绝佳机会。

636.en: There is a strong possibility of rain this afternoon.

637.en: The probability of winning the lottery is extremely low.

638.en: We can say with certainty that the climate is changing.
638.zh: 我们可以肯定地说气候正在变化。

639.en: Economic uncertainty makes companies cautious about hiring.
639.zh: 经济的不确定性使公司在招聘上很谨慎。

640.en: Practice speaking every day to build your confidence.
640.zh: 每天练习口语来建立信心。

641.en: There is little doubt that exercise improves health.
641.zh: 锻炼能改善健康，这一点几乎毫无疑问。

642.en: It is his belief that everyone can learn to draw.
642.zh: 他相信每个人都能学会画画。

643.en: In my opinion, the city needs more cycle paths.
643.zh: 在我看来，这座城市需要更多自行车道。

644.en: A positive attitude helps you cope with exam stress.
644.zh: 积极的态度帮助你应对考试压力。

645.en: The zoo studies the behavior of animals in captivity.
645.zh: 动物园研究圈养动物的行为。

646.en: Travelling alone helped shape her independent character.
646.zh: 独自旅行塑造了她独立的性格。

647.en: Music is a powerful way to express emotion.
647.zh: 音乐是表达情感的有力方式。

648.en: I had a feeling that the lecture had been cancelled.
648.zh: 我有种预感，讲座被取消了。

649.en: Sunny weather always puts me in a good mood.
649.zh: 晴朗的天气总能让我心情愉快。

650.en: Her passion for wildlife led her to study zoology.
650.zh: 她对野生动物的热爱使她选择了动物学。

651.en: The new coach brought great enthusiasm to the team.
651.zh: 新教练给球队带来了极大的热情。

652.en: Clear goals can increase your motivation to study.
652.zh: 明确的目标能增强你学习的动力。

653.en: The designer found inspiration in traditional Japanese art.
653.zh: 这位设计师从日本传统艺术中找到了灵感。

654.en: Painting classes encourage creativity in young children.
654.zh: 绘画课能激发幼儿的创造力。

655.en: Reading novels is a great way to develop your imagination.
655.zh: 读小说是培养想象力的好方法。

656.en: The company is famous for innovation in electric cars.
656.zh: 这家公司以电动汽车领域的创新闻名。

657.en: The invention of the printing press changed education forever.
657.zh: 印刷机的发明永远改变了教育。

658.en: The discovery of penicillin saved millions of lives.
658.zh: 青霉素的发现拯救了数百万人的生命。

659.zh: 太空探索需要巨额投资。

660.en: The police carried out a thorough investigation of the incident.
660.zh: 警方对这起事件进行了彻底调查。

661.en: Her research focuses on how children learn to read.
661.zh: 她的研究关注儿童如何学习阅读。

662.en: The essay includes a detailed analysis of the poem.
662.zh: 这篇论文对这首诗做了详细分析。

663.en: The course ends with an evaluation of each student's progress.
663.zh: 课程结束时会对每个学生的进步进行评估。

664.en: Continuous assessment counts for forty percent of the final mark.
664.zh: 平时考核占期末成绩的百分之四十。

665.en: The final examination covers everything taught this term.
665.zh: 期末考试涵盖本学期讲授的全部内容。

666.en: There will be a short listening test at the start of class.
666.zh: 课程开始时会有一个简短的听力测试。

667.en: The teacher gives a vocabulary quiz every Friday.
667.zh: 老师每周五进行一次词汇小测验。

668.en: The assignment must be handed in by the end of the month.
668.zh: 作业必须在月底前上交。

669.en: She finishes her homework before dinner every day.
669.zh: 她每天晚饭前完成家庭作业。

670.en: Our group project looks at recycling on campus.
670.zh: 我们的小组项目研究校园内的回收利用。

671.en: Each student gives a ten-minute presentation at the end of term.
671.zh: 每个学生在期末做十分钟的演示报告。

672.en: The lecture on climate change attracted a large audience.
672.zh: 关于气候变化的讲座吸引了大批听众。

673.en: We discuss the reading materials in the weekly seminar.
673.zh: 我们在每周的研讨会上讨论阅读材料。

674.en: The writing workshop helps students improve their essays.
674.zh: 写作工作坊帮助学生改进论文。

675.en: She presented her findings at an international conference.
675.zh: 她在一次国际会议上展示了自己的研究成果。

676.en: The next staff meeting is scheduled for Tuesday morning.
676.zh: 下一次员工会议定于周二上午举行。

677.en: I have an appointment with my tutor at three o'clock.
677.zh: 我三点钟和导师有个约谈。

678.en: She felt confident after her interview for the scholarship.
678.zh: 奖学金面试之后她感觉很有信心。

679.en: We had a long conversation about life in Australia.
679.zh: 我们就澳大利亚的生活聊了很久。

680.en: Practise the dialogue with a partner before class.
680.zh: 课前和同伴练习这段对话。

681.en: The discussion focused on ways to reduce food waste.
681.zh: 讨论集中在减少食物浪费的方法上。

682.en: The class held a debate on banning cars from the city centre.
682.zh: 全班就市中心禁行汽车举行了一场辩论。

683.en: The author's main argument is supported by strong evidence.
683.zh: 作者的主要论点有有力的证据支持。

684.en: There was some disagreement about where to hold the event.
684.zh: 关于活动地点存在一些分歧。

685.en: The two sides finally reached an agreement on the price.
685.zh: 双方最终就价格达成了一致。

686.en: After hours of discussion, the committee reached a consensus.
686.zh: 经过数小时讨论，委员会达成了共识。

687.en: International cooperation is essential to fight climate change.
687.zh: 应对气候变化离不开国际合作。

688.en: The project is a collaboration between two universities.
688.zh: 这个项目是两所大学之间的协作。

689.en: The museum formed a partnership with local schools.
689.zh: 博物馆与当地学校建立了伙伴关系。

690.en: A good relationship with your tutor makes studying easier.
690.zh: 与导师保持良好关系会让学习更轻松。

691.en: Their friendship began in the first week of university.
691.zh: 他们的友谊始于大学的第一周。

692.en: Many elderly people keep pets for companionship.
692.zh: 许多老年人养宠物作伴。

693.en: Researchers found a connection between diet and sleep quality.
693.zh: 研究人员发现饮食与睡眠质量之间存在联系。

694.en: Email is still the main form of communication at work.
694.zh: 电子邮件仍是工作中主要的沟通方式。

695.en: The app encourages interaction between learners around the world.
695.zh: 这款应用鼓励世界各地学习者之间的互动。

696.en: The two universities run a student exchange programme.
696.zh: 这两所大学开展学生交换项目。

697.en: The sharing of lecture notes is encouraged in this course.
697.zh: 这门课程鼓励分享课堂笔记。

698.en: The charity oversees the distribution of food to the villages.
698.zh: 慈善机构负责向村庄分发食物。

699.en: The allocation of rooms is done on a first-come, first-served basis.
699.zh: 房间按先到先得的原则分配。

700.en: The seating arrangement for the ceremony has been changed.
700.zh: 典礼的座位安排已经调整。
